    StartersPickled herring on ryePickled herring with sour cream, dill and red onion on buttered dark ryeHow to make it300g pickled herring150g sour cream1 small bunch dill1/2 red onion6 slices of dark rye bread20g butter, softenedDrain the herring and cut into bite pieces.Mix with the sour cream, chopped dill and thinly sliced red onion.Butter the rye, cut into squares and spoon the herring on top.Rostavili's Georgian cheese breadBoat-shaped bread filled with melted mozzarella and fetaHow to make it500g pizza dough200g mozzarella200g feta4 eggs40g butterHeat the oven to 230°C. Roll the dough into ovals.Fill with mozzarella mixed with crumbled feta and fold the edges up into boat shapes.Bake until golden.Crack an egg into each and bake a little longer.Add a knob of butter and stir at the table.MainsRidzik's Chicago beef stroganoffSeared beef strips in a mushroom, paprika and sour cream sauce over egg noodlesHow to make it600g eye fillet, cut into strips2 tbsp neutral oil300g mushrooms1 onion1 tsp paprika1 tbsp Dijon mustard250ml beef stock200g sour cream400g egg noodlesSlice the onion and mushrooms.Sear the eye fillet strips fast in batches in the neutral oil and set aside.Brown the mushrooms and onion, add the paprika, Dijon and stock and reduce.Boil the noodles and drain.Stir in the sour cream off the heat and return the beef. Serve over the noodles.Ridzik's Chicago deep dish sausage pizzaRidzik's turf in ChicagoHow to make itAs written, serves 4Buttery cornmeal crust pressed up a deep tin, layered with mozzarella, Italian sausage and chunky tomato sauce, topped with parmesan and baked golden.Mix 350g plain flour, 50g cornmeal, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt, 60g melted butter and 230ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour.Press into a greased 25cm deep tin, up the sides.Layer 250g sliced mozzarella, then 400g Italian sausage meat pressed into a flat layer.Simmer 400g crushed tomatoes with garlic and oregano for 10 minutes and spread on top.Scatter 40g grated parmesan and bake at 220°C for 35 minutes.Rest 10 minutes before slicing.SweetsWatch swap medovikThin honey cake layers stacked with sour cream and condensed milk creamHow to make it100g honey100g butter150g caster sugar3 eggs1 tsp bicarbonate of soda450g plain flour600g sour cream395g sweetened condensed milk (1 tin)Melt the honey, butter and sugar, then whisk in the eggs and bicarbonate of soda, then the flour to a dough.Roll the dough into thin discs.Bake each disc, keeping the offcuts for crumbs, in a 180°C oven.Beat the sour cream with the condensed milk.Layer the discs with the cream.Crush the offcuts and coat the cake in the crumbs.Rest the cake overnight in the fridge.DrinksDanko's cranberry mors and vodka coolerHomemade cranberry juice with honey and lemon, vodka and soda over iceHow to make it300g frozen cranberries, for the mors600ml water4 tbsp honey2 lemons1 tray ice160ml vodka240ml soda water20g frozen cranberries, for garnishSimmer the cranberries with the water and honey, crushing the berries.Strain, add the juice of one lemon and chill the mors.Fill tall glasses with ice. Add vodka and mors to each, top with soda water and stir.Garnish with a few frozen cranberries and a lemon slice.
